hml.text: Thexar, an Anaba minotaur, led his group to their ancestral caverns with his navigational skill.
He then underwent a scarring ceremony meant to mark his adulthood, overseen by the inexperienced Neth'arna, and it went tragically wrong.
Arras tends the dying Thexar and tells stories of past warriors to distract him from his pain, while Neth'arna declares his death imminent and he pleads for death and accuses her.
Thexar dies, and the minotaur workers abandon their tasks to mourn.
